author: Retro Game Corps
description:
We finally have the full details on Retroid's upcoming compact 4:3 handheld, so let's talk about it.

The RP Nova goes on sale 26JUN at 9pm ET (6pm PT). It will show "sold out" until then: https://tinyurl.com/RPNovaPreview

** Update: it looks like for those who pre-order the device, that optional ergonomic back plate will come free, along with a screen protector.
